name: CONSISTENT DATA
old_stance: Nuclear power is the only viable zero-emission baseload energy source capable of replacing fossil fuels at scale without geographic constraints.
new_stance: While initial capital costs are high, the exceptional energy density and 60-year operational lifespans of nuclear plants mathematically offset these early expenses.

name: INCONSISTENT DATA
old_stance: Nuclear power must be the permanent backbone of our energy grid because intermittent sources like wind and solar rely on unproven, highly degraded grid-scale battery storage.
new_stance: Nuclear plants are indeed centralized, which is exactly why they should merely serve as a temporary bridge until our grid-scale battery infrastructure is fully matured for a 100% renewable grid.
